author: Divine Insights
session_date_or_event: Echoes of Sedona (official event date November 23, 2024; not stated in transcript)
opening_summary: Bashar addresses reactions to controversial statements made during a previous Sedona transmission. He clarifies that the information came directly from him, not the channel (Darryl Anka), and represents observations of spacetime energies rather than predictions or opinions. The statements about feminine and masculine energy leading to different contact scenarios were intentionally designed to accelerate the 'splitting of the prism' in human reality. Bashar emphasizes that contact with extraterrestrials is now inevitable, likely occurring within five years, possibly in late 2026 or early 2027. The transmission underscores that humanity's choices determine the style and nature of contact, and encourages maintaining balanced, positive states regardless of belief systems.

quotes.quote: We are not giving you an opinion. We are telling you what we see.
The splitting of the prism that is going on in your reality will accelerate.
Contact is now inevitable, at this point in your timelines inevitable.
It will be within the next five of your years, possibly late 2026, early 2027.
Unity is inevitable, but only through validation of differences.
You are all actors and once the play is over you recognize you chose your parts.
